lines.1: Tests came back one after another.
lines.4: I'd gotten through every subject with pretty decent grades.
lines.5: 「Ghh... that was close. I just squeaked past the failing mark.」
lines.6: 「Hey, good things happen as long as you're alive.」
lines.7: I gently patted Crab on the head.
lines.10: I showed her an ad from the back of a boys' magazine.
lines.11: 「Huh? Just a tiny bit of studying and your grades soar in no time!? Awesome! It really works!」
lines.12: Not like I could tell her the truth.
lines.13: I really am a considerate guy.
lines.17: 「It's kind of weird seeing you under normal circumstances.」
lines.18: 「Well, the weekend was way too unusual.」
lines.20: 「Yeah, thanks to you, I did great.」
lines.21: 「Looks like you're... the same as ever, too.」
lines.22: The list of top students posted in the hallway.
lines.25: 「Next time, I'm going to work hard and aim for the top ten.」
lines.31: 「Someday, I want to do something about that number-one spot.」
lines.32: Her rivalry with the Princess was as fierce as ever.
lines.33: 「Their conversation sure sounds a lot more natural now.」
lines.34: 「Grrr... damn that Leo. I don't know why, but I can't let this stand.」
lines.35: 「Let's all interrogate him and find out what's going on!」
lines.36: 「Leo'll tell us himself when the time comes.」
lines.37: 「Shut up! We're making our move tomorrow!」
